annotations.text:
Three whole screens. Everything right of the rail is identical in all three — only the switch at the top of the left nav changes, so compare that and nothing else.

State shown: two agents running under the focused session (the pills), one session waiting on you (the badge and the orange line), one auto-mode session, one sleeping.
A · SEGMENTED — what ships today. A pill pair in a tray: unmistakable, and the lit half is where you are. Costs a full row of rail height, and the tray is a shape the app uses nowhere else.
B · UNDERLINE — two words on a hairline, the active one lit by the orange accent. This is the grammar the rail already speaks for an active row, so it adds no new shape and saves a line. My pick.

C · ONE LINE, ONE SWAP — names only where you are; the other side is a quiet swap on the right. Shortest of the three, and the badge still reads because it describes the side you are NOT on. Costs you the constant sight of both destinations.
